reason: A notification plugin that manages multiple delivery channels and exposes push services for other plugins and local integrations; the README also documents external message delivery and plaintext local credential storage.

summaries.zh: 管理多个消息推送渠道，并通过界面、进程内服务和本地 HTTP 接口向其他插件发送通知。
summaries.en: Manages multiple message delivery channels and lets the interface, in-process service, and local HTTP API send notifications for other plugins.

capabilities: Sends messages through configured external notification channels
Exposes an in-process pushNotifier service and a local HTTP API for other plugins
Stores channel credentials and tokens in a local JSON file
